name: Plane Woodworking
old_description: In today's disposable world, choose furniture that endures. Ditch mass-produced, disposable pieces for the timeless beauty of custom solid wood. Sure, the initial cost may be higher, but consider it an investment in quality and longevity.
about:
Plane Woodworking operates from Cinnaminson, New Jersey, where founder Bill transformed a personal woodworking hobby into a business aimed at supporting his family and connecting with the local community. The venture began with a desire to create lasting, handcrafted pieces rather than mass-produced alternatives, though the exact founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The shop produces custom solid-wood furniture including desks, bed frames, shelving, cabinets, millwork, and trim, along with personalized cutting boards. It also offers a DIY wood cutting and drilling service for homeowners and professionals, handling materials such as sustainably sourced hardwoods, plywood, MDF, laminate, and butcher block. Precision cutting and drilling are performed with advanced equipment, though specific machine models are not listed.

Customers range from residential clients in the Cinnaminson area to businesses seeking engraved gifts for clients or employees. The company serves DIY enthusiasts needing cut-to-size components for countertops, shelving systems, or IKEA modifications, as well as professional woodworkers requiring accurate fabrication.

Bill emphasizes community and environmental stewardship: three percent of every sale funds tree planting through One Tree Planted, and materials are sourced from other small businesses whenever possible. The focus on solid wood allows pieces to be sanded, refinished, and handed down, contrasting with disposable furniture. Free consultations and fast turnaround times are offered to reduce waste and deliver professional results.
